decisions.statement: Every condition of a match must hold for that match to hold.
A match stating no condition holds of every case.
A negated condition holds where no value that condition names holds.
A condition on a field the rule set did not declare holds of nothing.
A condition on a list field holds of nothing, a list having no realiser here.
Nothing here walks the cases a rule set can tell apart.

definition: whether the conditions a rule states hold of one case
